verdict.rationale: The MI325X is hardware that customers deploy in their own systems. First-party docs cover acceptance and validation of an 8-GPU MI325X server, Kubernetes deployment through the GPU Operator, container integration, and an open-source ROCm software stack, all running on the user's own infrastructure. One commenter's doubt about whether ordinary buyers can obtain the part is availability skepticism, not a concrete contradiction of self-hosting, so it lowers confidence only. Missing for 10: a documented on-prem procurement path for ordinary buyers, independent hands-on corroboration of self-hosted MI325X deployments.
